# Agency Agents attribution and review

FIRBO adapts five personas from `msitarzewski/agency-agents`, MIT licensed,
copyright (c) 2025 AgentLand Contributors. The full license is in LICENSE and
also ships in the web build at `/notices/agency-agents.txt`.

Reviewed immutable revision: `f99f6aa910a442b0197b768ce0ea7751e35e2060`.
`manifest.json` records both upstream Git blob IDs and SHA256 for all six exact
source/license snapshots. These markdown files are review evidence; no code,
shell commands, tool declaration or installation instruction in them is executed.
They are not imported into the web bundle or runtime prompt verbatim.

| Reviewed source | Existing FIRBO template | Method retained |
| --- | --- | --- |
| research/research-synthesist.md | deep-research | Question framing, source independence, evidence grading, conflicting findings and gaps |
| engineering/engineering-backend-architect.md | autonomous-coder | Compatible contracts, targeted changes, reliability, verification and rollback |
| testing/testing-evidence-collector.md | qa-engineer | Reproduction, requirement-based evidence, appearance vs behavior, explicit untested scope |
| engineering/engineering-devops-automator.md | devops-engineer | Environment identity, incident/release checks, recovery and measured outcomes |
| marketing/marketing-content-creator.md | content-writer | Company voice, channel-specific deliverables, editorial planning and verified facts |

The bounded FIRBO methods in `frontend/src/lib/company/agencySpecialists.ts`
omit unsupported claims of permanent memory, hypothetical success percentages,
global installs, example commands, unrelated platform tools and assumed access.
No new permission, plan entitlement or automatic deployment is granted.
Existing employee records and owner instructions are not overwritten.

The native `agency-agents-app` is a separate persona installer, not installed here.
An adapted method is not a new model or execution engine. No quality improvement
or live task completion is claimed from catalog, UI or mocked-RPC tests alone.
